title: Buddy Petit's lake boat band and playing with Dumaine at the Bungalow
summary: He played with Buddy Petit on a boat from West End on the lake, recalls the band's players, and then names the Louis Dumaine lineup at the Bungalow.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Was he with you the same time? No, George wasn't, I didn't play with Chris. Chris was playing at the Bull at that time when George was playing with him. Yeah, I remember that. He played with Chris. And I also work with Buddy Petit on a boat they call a Susquehanna.
Yeah, that left from out at West End. Oh, on the lake? On the lake, and they go for his Miamiville. Yeah.
And Buddy Petit played on it? Yeah, Buddy Petit played on it.

What kind of band did he have? He had a jazz band. How big was it? Yeah, a jazz band. Who else was in it? Buddy Petit and a fella by the name of Buddy Manatee. Oh yeah, the band. He's from over the lake, yeah. You know that boy by the name. Oral Foster played with him. You might know Oral Foster, he's a drummer. Is that one they call Chinese?

Chinese used to play with Papa Celestein years ago. Yeah, his name is Foster, don't you? Yeah, Oral Foster. What's his first name? I never did know nothing but Chinese. I never did know nothing but Chinese. I never did know a thing but Chinese. I never did know anything but Chinese. I never did know anything but Chinese. I never did know anything but Chinese. Chinese. And I also played with Luis DuMaine out at the Bungalow. That was out at the West End too. Meet Luis DuMaine and a fella by the name of, I can't think of his name. Anyway, the boy no name Wilkin playing drum, and Tom Parker playing saxophone, and a fella called Gabriel, played banjo. And Joe Watson, that's the one I was trying to think. He's a saxophone player in the clan that played Joe Watson. He's dead now though. Yeah, he's dead. Then I used to play a lot of house parties by myself too, on piano, yeah. A lot of house parties. I used to play for the superintendent of the Lane's Cotton Mill, Mr. Rickman. I used to play at his house lots of times.
